name: NodeMCU V3 (ESP-12E, CH340)
description: Cheap ESP8266 devkit (ESP-12E, CH340G, micro-USB) with all pins broken out on 2x15 headers and FLASH/RST buttons; the long-time Lua/Arduino Wi-Fi beginner board at about $3.5.
notes: 11 usable GPIOs (D0-D8, RX, TX); two more (SD2/SD3 = GPIO9/10) are usable only in DIO flash mode. Single 10-bit ADC on A0 (0-1 V on the chip, 3.3 V via divider on most boards).
The 'V3' LoLin board is 31 mm wide and covers a whole breadboard; the V2 'Amica' board is 26 mm and breadboard-friendly.
CH340G driver needed on some OSes. Legacy chip: prefer ESP32-C3 boards for new projects.
